parts.t: Canyon Heights sits at one of North Vancouver's most dramatic natural settings — bordering the Capilano River Canyon and offering immediate access to some of the best trails in the Lower Mainland. The neighbourhood is home to executive residences and families who prioritize nature, privacy, and top-tier schools
